description: Requested GitHub token-expired artboard; the unsupported host credential state remains an explicit gap.
gaps: Per-member contribution bindings are not produced by AppsService.read(); manifest contributions are names only.
Token permission labels do not expose credential storage or expiry state; no Saved status is inferred.
AppsService.act() has no token reconnect/save command, and AppsService.read() has no expired-token producer.
